messages:
Marta P: Noticing something odd on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate when comparing regions — p95 sits below p50 for the Europe vs US rollup. looks like inversion.
Julian K: hmm. is that the compare mode where you can toggle multiple breakouts?
Marta P: yes, compare=region. timeframe=last_3h. Numbers: EU p50 ~ 180ms, p95 ~ 160ms; US p50 ~ 140ms, p95 ~ 400ms
Sam L: that smells like a merge problem. If front-end blends per-region percentiles without weighting by sample_count you can get those inversions.
Nina S: we also recently changed the telemetry sampler for EU to 0.4 for the rollout, US stayed at 0.05. sampling mismatch + naive blend = weird results
Julian K: console code currently does: fetch percentiles per-slice, render side-by-side, and if in compare mode it takes the raw pctl numbers and shows them. No sample_count shown anywhere.
Marta P: users are confused because they trust p95 visually. we should surface sample counts immediately.
Sam L: agreed. short-term UX: add a small "samples" column and a tooltip that explains "percentiles are from tdigest merges; comparing groups with different sample sizes can be misleading". also add a warning badge when sample ratios > 3x.
Julian K: backend-wise we need tdigest + n returned per shard so the front-end can merge correctly if it wants, or we should add a server-side merged-percentiles endpoint.
Nina S: ops note: sampler for EU canary was raised to 0.4 to help debugging, forgot to revert. I can lower it to 0.05 now. that'll at least make sampling consistent across regions for this rollout.
Sam L: for console queries a recommended pattern (pseudo):
```
WITH shards AS (
  SELECT tdigest_blob, sample_count FROM metrics
  WHERE route='generate' AND region='eu'
)
SELECT percentiles(merge_tdigest(tdigest_blob, sample_count), 50, 95, 99)
```
That gives correct merged percentiles.
Julian K: plan: 1) Nina revert EU sampler now (done) 2) frontend PR to show samples + warning by EOD (Julian) 3) backend: metrics-service add sample_count + raw tdigest field and a merged-percentiles endpoint (Sam/Nina) targeting next week 4) add e2e regression that simulates mismatched sampling (Julian)
ops-bot: Deployment queued: metrics-service v2.3 -> canary (scheduled)
Marta P: also please add an explanation in the rollout UX docs because PMs keep using compare mode to judge canary perf and this will keep tripping them up.
Sam L: will add a short doc snippet and link in the tooltip.
Julian K: temporary mitigation in the UI: disable percentiles comparison when sample counts differ hugely and show a banner recommending server-merge for accurate percentiles.
Nina S: i've reverted the sampler and kicked a new telemetry deploy to EU nodes (logs: infra/telemetry/2004567890).
Marta P: thanks. if anyone sees other endpoints with pctl inversions please paste the slice here and tag me. :thumbsup:
Julian K: PR opened for samples column: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/3121 (won't affect production until backend API available)
Sam L: adding ticket METRICS-842 to expose merged tdigest endpoint and sample_count.
Marta P: great work. follow-ups: add alert if dashboard compare triggers inversion for critical routes (SLO-sensitive).
ops-bot: Alert rule created: pctl-inversion-detect -> notify #incidents (created by Marta P)
Marta P: closing loop — nice cross-team triage.
